title: Alexander the Great
summary: Alexander the Great was a Seeker and ancient Greek king who founded the coastal city of Alexandria during his numerous conquests.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Alexander founded the coastal city of [[Alexandria]] where he has his [[Dark Triton]] and three [[Triton]] [[Titans]] guard the famous lighthouse there, inspiring the legend of the four guardian juggernauts. After his death, the four [[Amulets]] were buried beneath the city in the depths of the ocean. {{source|The Treasures of Alexandria}}

Many centuries later, the three Tritons were recovered by [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Dante Vale]] who gave his Amulet to [[Zhalia Moon]]. Dark Triton initially fell into the hands of [[Captain Caine]] of the [[Organization]] who gave it to [[Gregor]] but it was then claimed by Dante. {{source|The Treasures of Alexandria}}

full_text:
Alexander the Great was a Seeker and ancient Greek king who founded the coastal city of Alexandria during his numerous conquests.

History

Alexander founded the coastal city of Alexandria where he has his Dark Triton and three Triton Titans guard the famous lighthouse there, inspiring the legend of the four guardian juggernauts. After his death, the four Amulets were buried beneath the city in the depths of the ocean. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Many centuries later, the three Tritons were recovered by Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Dante Vale who gave his Amulet to Zhalia Moon. Dark Triton initially fell into the hands of Captain Caine of the Organization who gave it to Gregor but it was then claimed by Dante. [The Treasures of Alexandria]

Abilities

Alexander was a skilled Seeker and powerful conqueror who succeeded in building one of the greatest empires of the ancient world.
